Use case: ui-mockup. Create a premium mobile puzzle game COLLECTION screen ART BACKPLATE without text. Portrait 1125x2436, exactly aspect 375:812. This is a sibling screen to attached approved game references, not a redesign of those references. Image 1 approved menu: authoritative toy-like hand-carved architectural style, warm light, saturation, thick chunky golden carvings. Image 2 approved pause card: authoritative ballooned teal/gold header, chunky rounded bevels, soft broad reflections and thick cream/gold UI. Image 3 level button: authoritative exquisite thick gold material. Image 4 Royal Match gallery: ONLY reference for room density, warm lively room composition and craftsmanship, NEVER copy its royal characters, heraldry, paws, crowns, branding, statues, purple identity.
Create our own warm brightly lit museum gallery room with PETROL/TURQUOISE walls, ornate golden moldings, cream marble, red carpet visible at lower edges, sunlight from arched windows. Full colorful architecture and rich warm illumination, no dark veil, no broad empty dark areas, no web dashboard flatness.
Coordinates below are in LOGICAL 375x812 units (multiply by 3 for pixels). Preserve these layout slots very closely:
- top y0..44 decorative room only, no UI (phone notch safe area).
- Header: enormous puffy turquoise enamel ribbon/plaque with thick curled gold ends at x12,y51,width239,height66. Center left plaque EMPTY for later title. At x263,y65,width100,height38 leave clear wall space for later approved cream/gold counter-pill overlay.
- Gallery wall display: FIFTEEN chunky, rounded hand-carved gold picture frames in precise 3 columns by 5 rows. All frames frontal to camera, no perspective distortion in frame interiors, identical positions and sizes. Column frame boxes x=17,137,257; width=101. Row frame boxes y=149,258,367,476,585; height=78. Each frame has thick sumptuous gold edges and an EMPTY solid petrol rectangular inset centered in frame, with inner content rectangle x+10,y+10,width81,height58 for later REAL game painting overlay. NO painted images in these fifteen insets. Below every frame leave clear wall space y+79..y+104 for 15pt labels or three stars added later. Keep frames horizontal aspect~1.3 and chunky like the approved carving. Subtle luminous emphasis around frame number12 (row4,col3) only.
- Bottom y711..778 room floor only, no UI, no labels: existing original bottom nav gets composited later.
- Bottom y778..812 room floor only, system homebar safe area.
NO text, NO letters, NO numerals, NO symbols in frame interiors. NO currency, hearts, shop or purchase objects. NO green UI. No Royal Match assets or emblems.
Mandatory gold palette #FBBA0E highlight #F38A03 body #CE5D01 shade #FFF1C2 small glints; teal #1C7F8C #0F4F5A, cream #F8EBD0, outlines #0B2A36, carpet red #D62822/#94160F. All lighting blends within these families, not washed-out ochre. Polished high-end animated film 3D game render with tactile volume and thick buttery gold edges. Deliver a finished lovely room + fifteen empty ornate frames + blank puffy title plaque.
achievements:
Use case: ui-mockup. Create a premium portrait mobile puzzle game's ACHIEVEMENTS SCREEN art backplate, NO TEXT, 1125x2436 pixels, 375:812 aspect. A sibling of attached approved menu and pause-card art. Images1/2 are the absolute art-direction authority: rich warm lighting, intensely saturated petrol/turquoise enamel, thick curled gold carving, buttery chunky rounded toy bevels. Image3 approved play button gives exact gold quality. Image4 Royal Match dense screen is ONLY craftsmanship/density reference; do not copy any character, logo, emblem, paw or crown from it.
Scene: OUR OWN glorious brightly sunlit trophy hall attached to our petrol-walled museum, red velvet curtains, arches, chunky golden moldings, warm cream stone plinths, foreground marble and red carpet. Decorative original star and puzzle-piece trophies in side niches. No human characters. Bright warm high-end animated-film game render. NO dark veil, no navy void, no flat dashboard.
Strict placement uses LOGICAL375x812 units (multiply by3):
- y0..44 only beautiful background architecture, notch-safe.
- Blank enormous inflated teal-enamel ribbon title plaque with thick gold curls at x12,y51,w239,h66; no text. Leave x263,y65,w100,h38 wall area clear for original counter pill overlay.
- FIVE full-width beautifully rounded chunky cream ACHIEVEMENT TILES at x14, width347; top y=151,263,375,487,599; height100. These are physically thick gorgeous 3D golden picture-card trays, NOT flat rectangles. Thick gold outer rim, orange-gold side thickness, cream interior, subtle cream upper gleam and dark teal thin inner shadow, same material treatment as approved pause panel.
- Each row has a LARGE 3D golden round medallion on left at x29..91,y+18..80. Row1 emblem a framed painting. Row2 emblem three overlapping framed paintings. Row3 emblem a big rounded bomb with clearly separate curved fuse (gold/teal/cream only). Row4 emblem a five-point star. Row5 emblem an original broad-brimmed top hat, dark gray-teal muted locked medallion (not a royal crown).
- In every tile leave TEXT AREA ENTIRELY BLANK, cream and uncluttered, x105..342,y+10..y+68. Add no pseudo-text or lines.
- In every tile provide a FAT puffy turquoise-and-gold progress track at x107,y+75,w192,h18, with a teal inset. Row1 and2 completely filled teal; row3 70%; row4 30%; row5 empty dark gray-teal. Track has rounded gold rim and brilliant broad edge highlights. No green.
- On right edge of rows1/2 include a chunky turquoise embossed checkmark x322,y+28,size19. For rows3/4 no status symbol (text/progress comes later). Row5 small tasteful gold/teal padlock x325,y+27,size19.
- y711..778 room floor only; no nav: original nav will be composited later.
- y778..812 uninterrupted scene floor only, home-bar-safe.
NO text/letters/numerals ANYWHERE. NO currency, heart, shop, dollar, purchasing, crown. Preserve all five empty label areas. Work at 3D toy finish, beautiful smooth broad reflections and strong warm light, no thin linework.
Mandatory palette: gold #FBBA0E highlight #F38A03 body #CE5D01 shadows #FFF1C2 tiny glints; teal #1C7F8C #0F4F5A; cream #F8EBD0; ink #0B2A36; red #D62822 #94160F. All gold must be from these blends, saturated not dull bronze. The medallions must feel dimensional and friendly like the approved original assets.
